description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the lands in Nikagolla, Yatawattha D/S Division, Matale District - Ipalawa, Wariyapoa D/S Division, Kurunegala District  and Wattakkaliya, Chillaw D/S Division, Puttalam District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains three separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties for water supply and sewerage projects. Each order includes detailed descriptions of the land parcels, including lot numbers, names of lands, boundaries, and claimants' information. While a government minister is named and exercises statutory authority, the core content focuses on land acquisition and property descriptions rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
